description: Resolves a postal code in one country (ISO 2-letter code, e.g. US, DE, TR, GB) to its place names, state or province, and latitude and longitude, from Zippopotam.us. Covers only the countries that service publishes. No time zone or administrative municipality is returned, since no free source for them was used. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code, e.g. US, DE, TR, GB

postalCode.description: Postal code as written for that country, 2 to 12 characters
